name: Pasir Ris West Fringe
summary: West edge of Pasir Ris toward Tampines / Loyang — quieter east-coast fringe living with park connectors and ActiveSG catchment.
body: Pasir Ris West Fringe is the shortlist when quieter east-coast fringe living and park-connector texture matter more than CBD skyline premiums. The pocket sits on the Pasir Ris West / Tampines / Loyang edges; housing mixes mid-age HDB, executive condos, and selective private stock. Expats land here for car-light hops to Pasir Ris / Tampines and ActiveSG gateball / petanque catchment without Orchard rents. Watch-outs: smoke-stop / staircase pressurisation fan test notices on mid-rises, weekend park-connector crowds, and confusing Pasir Ris vs Pasir Ris West Fringe shortlists. Compare with Loyang Edge for quieter industrial-fringe calm, Tampines North Edge for denser new-town texture, and Pasir Ris proper when beach-park gravity wins.
